sources.title: BGE-Reranker-V2-M3 - GitHub
sources.snippet: BGE-Reranker-V2-M3 is a cross-encoder reranker model developed by BAAI, based on the RoBERTa architecture. Unlike decoder-only LLM-based rerankers, it is a lightweight (278M parameters) encoder-only model that directly computes relevance scores for (query, document) pairs.
